'''Theodohr''' is the commander of the [[Andor]]an cavalry during the [[Last Battle]].{{ref/book|14|37}}

== Activities ==
Theodohr advises Queen [[Elayne Trakand|Elayne]] against retreat and says that they should hope that the [[Aes Sedai]] can win out against the [[Seanchan]].{{ref/book|14|37}}

== Trivia ==
* Theodohr is named for Theodore Herman, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
